Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

aquaTrajectories 0.2.1 (Source-frozen engineering qualification; 2026-11-23)

This is a patch release of the existing analytical API, not a claim of independent fish-detection, animal-identity, physical XYZ or welfare validation.

  • Incorporates the complete source and regression suite merged in PR #113: boundary and failure-path handling, strict tests and publication workflows.
  • Retains 188 documented R exports and all v0.2.0 scientific safeguards.
  • Requires exact-source, three-OS, zero-error/warning/note R CMD check, the locked synthetic source-row/Python oracle, evidence workflows and 24 measured 2D/3D benchmark workloads on each platform.
  • Requires 100.0000% instrumented R code coverage AND zero unexecuted expression records. Coverage denominators across revisions may differ.
  • Creates immutable v0.2.1 only from a fully qualified main SHA, preserving the v0.2.0 tag/release and all other historical tags.
  • Assets include R source, SHA-256 checksums, cross-platform evidence and complete actual covr instrumented-expression audits.

See docs/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_0_2_1.md and docs/RELEASE_NOTES_0_2_1.md. Software coverage and synthetic tests do NOT certify biological detection, persistent fish identity, physical XYZ, independent animal replication, welfare, causal inference or device safety.

aquaTrajectories 0.2.0 (Scientific safeguards and reproducible research)

This planned software release extends the qualified v0.1.2 analytical core. It is not a certification of empirical fish detection, persistent animal identity, physical underwater 3D measurement, feeding causality, fish welfare or hardware safety.

  • 188 documented public R functions across 15 scientific reference categories, including nine post-v0.1.2 evidence-safeguard functions.
  • Source-preserving estimator specification comparisons: pooled, track-, fragment- and equal-time-window sensitivity, numerical denominators and explicit direction-reversal flags.
  • Explicit measurement contracts distinguishing image pixels, supplied auxiliary measurements and independently calibrated physical XYZ; mixed- axis plots are display-only until physical calibration evidence is supplied.
  • Independent-unit readiness, spatial-support diagnostics, bounding-box/ image-geometry associations, within-recording placebo boundaries and conservative source-linked evidence reporting with SHA-256 manifests.
  • Portable SVG and high-resolution PNG output for frame-index reports, preferring optional svglite/ragg devices and verifying complete SVG files.
  • Known-truth synthetic regressions and executable cross-platform R Markdown reports for the added evidence functions; no original SmartFish empirical recordings, analytical workbooks or manuscript are distributed.
  • Preserve the v0.1.2 synthetic QC/independent-Python oracle and numerical measurement workflows as reproducible baselines; any new qualification statistics must come from the actual v0.2.0 source at its exact commit.
  • Historic v0.1.0, v0.1.1 and v0.1.2 tags and their source archives are immutable.

See docs/RELEASE_CANDIDATE_0_2_0.md for six release gates and docs/RELEASE_NOTES_0_2_0.md for bounded public claims.

aquaTrajectories 0.1.2 (Reproducible Research Release; 2026-11-21)

This is a versioned software-engineering and research-reproducibility release, not a claim that independently validated biological fish identity, physical underwater accuracy, welfare or uncertainty coverage is established.

  • 179 public R exports spanning core 2D/3D movement, school geometry, quality-control and publication visualization.
  • Complete QC 2.0 source-row exclusion lineage, original-data preservation and source-bound trajectory plotting; 22 public native plots and six headless 3D scene regression tests with four cross-OS pixel-golden tests.
  • Independent numerical-validation matrix for nine scientific method groups, including synthetic oracles, metamorphic properties and negative cases.
  • Locked 17-row synthetic trajectory-to-report example with annotated missing observation, nonadjacent frame and speed exclusion, verified by independent stdlib Python recomputation of 10 eligible Euclidean steps (total 10 cm); source/input/report/figure SHA-256 manifests.
  • Actual instrumented covr execution coverage (80% minimum for this release), recorded function/source lineage and measured R runtime/memory allocation for 2D/3D workloads on Windows, Linux and macOS; the numeric correctness of benchmarks is a gate, not claims about speed superiority.
  • Strict built R CMD check, three-platform benchmark/provenance tests, Python numerical oracle, artifact checks and release-only version guards.
  • Publish a new immutable v0.1.2 GitHub source release only from a qualified merged commit. A version-specific Zenodo DOI must not be carried forward from v0.1.1 unless a new archive record is issued.

The locked example is synthetic and publicly redistributable. Real fish video, external ground truth, model weights and calibration data are neither included nor fabricated. No automatic empirical-scientific certification is implied.

aquaTrajectories 0.1.1 (documentation and citation release)

Documentation-focused engineering-preview update to the existing 0.1.0 software. No new independent empirical fish, underwater metrology, welfare or hardware-control validation is claimed.

  • Publish the research website source with a guarded Pages Actions deployment; the existing working gh-pages publishing branch remains intact.
  • Add the complete pkgdown reference for all 155 public R exports in 14 groups, plus 16 scientific-methods articles and the interactive synthetic 2D/3D fish-trajectory research explorer.
  • Add reproducible scientific figure galleries, original SVG illustrations, and website build and reference integrity tests.
  • Add root CITATION.cff metadata (creator, ORCID, license, scope and software version) for GitHub’s Cite menu and Zenodo archival.
  • Preserve the 0.1.0 scientific safeguards: engineering qualification is not independent fish identity, ecological, welfare, underwater XYZ or physical ACI safety certification.

Reproducibility and archival

Source releases intentionally contain no private fish recordings, human annotation exports, proprietary model weights, secrets or private datasets. A Zenodo DOI, if issued after the GitHub release, identifies the archived software version and does not establish scientific validity.

aquaTrajectories 0.1.0 (release candidate; 2026-11-14)

First versioned engineering software release candidate of AquaTrajectories.

Implemented software capabilities

  • 155 public R aqt_* functions for 2D/3D aquatic trajectories, movement and group metrics, event alignment, detection/tracking evaluation, calibrated and refraction-aware reconstruction, and uncertainty-aware behavioural summaries.
  • Configurable Python video tracking and multiview-to-native-R pipelines, with camera-local video frame PTS and explicit provenance checks.
  • Local 2D/3D multiview researcher explorer and opt-in simulator-tested physical ACI bridge.
  • Independent engineering and scientific-release gates. The latter is intentionally fail-closed pending external validation.

Release qualification and bug fixes

  • Exact public main commit 280914063edf47edc72a2d97e5b010423992fee5 passed the private-user-executed public-source-only whole-package engineering audit on Windows R 4.6.1 on 2026-11-14: 41 PASS, zero FAIL, two nonblocking REVIEW stages.
  • R testthat, built R CMD check (no errors, warnings or notes), Python contracts, Node explorer tests, synthetic video bundle to R, 200 randomized trajectory checks, and six-feature engineering gate passed.
  • Canonical 2D CSV import of all-NA z now works; canonical numeric time/coordinates use consistent double storage after import.
  • Track identifiers retain exact zero-padded strings in canonical, YOLO, and idtracker.ai CSV imports; unmatched event alignment is robust.
  • Release candidate adds direct synthetic regression tests for three previously unreferenced plotting exports: aqt_plot_paths(), aqt_plot_joint_scene_cloud3d(), aqt_plot_tank_scene3d(). Optional rgl rendering is conditional on the rgl dependency being installed.

Explicit limitations

Engineering gate pass is not scientific certification. Independently adjudicated biological identities, original video/source detector accuracy over diverse tanks/species, physical camera exposure synchronization, surveyed underwater XYZ and fish-length accuracy, external empirical uncertainty coverage, real device safety, and animal welfare validation remain outstanding. Synthetic tests must not be interpreted as evidence that any of these empirical requirements are satisfied.

The source distribution intentionally excludes private tracking data, original fish videos, detector weights, credentials and proprietary third-party datasets. Public benchmark datasets must be handled under their own licensing terms.

Historical publication status

Version 0.1.0 was published as the AquaTrajectories Engineering Preview GitHub release on 2026-11-14. The source was engineering-qualified only, and no independent scientific accuracy certification was claimed.
